important_limits: 2019-2022 chose the design and blend weight, so its scores are not an independent result
2023-2026 was examined in earlier model research and is reused development evidence, not final promotion proof
posterior intervals omit uncertainty in the separately estimated calibration slope
production forecasts and betting behavior are unchanged
plain_language_conclusion: The improved Bayesian design did not add useful probability information to the logistic model on the later evaluation fights.
plain_language_method: Nine Bayesian designs were compared on 2019-2022 only. The best design and its logistic/Bayesian mixing weight were frozen before scoring 2023-2026. Every yearly forecast used only earlier fights.
